instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Accepts a pending authority nomination, completing ownership transfer.

instructions.name: add_hook_whitelist
docs: Whitelists a hook program by creating its `HookWhitelist` PDA. Authority-only.

instructions.name: claim_refund
docs: Permissionless refund for expired jobs. Tokens always go to `job.client`.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call — tokens always go to job.client

accounts.name: vault
docs: Optional: required when the job was Funded/Submitted with budget > 0

accounts.name: client_token_account
docs: Optional: required when the job was Funded/Submitted with budget > 0

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: acp_state.sponsor. Distinct from platform_treasury, which receives SPL fees.

instructions.name: complete
docs: Evaluator approves a submitted job, distributing escrowed funds.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Optional: required when budget > 0

accounts.name: provider_token_account
docs: Optional: required when budget > 0

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: Optional: required when budget > 0

accounts.name: evaluator_token_account
docs: Optional: required when evaluator_fee_bp > 0 and budget > 0

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: acp_state.sponsor. Distinct from platform_treasury, which receives SPL fees.

instructions.name: create_job
docs: Creates a new job in the Open state. Caller becomes the client.
`seed` is a client-chosen uniquifier, not a protocol sequence — the job's
identity is its own address. Any unused value works; `init` rejects a
reuse by the same client. Creations no longer contend on a shared counter,
so they are unbounded per slot.

accounts.name: hook_whitelist
docs: Optional: must be provided if hook_address is Some

instructions.name: detach_hook
docs: Detaches a misbehaving hook from an in-flight job so escrow keeps flowing. Authority-only.

instructions.name: fund
docs: Escrows tokens from the client into the vault and transitions the job to Funded.

accounts.name: client_token_account
docs: Optional: required when budget > 0

accounts.name: vault
docs: Per-job escrow vault, program-derived so its ADDRESS is unique to the job.
That, not a stored mint, is what makes `vault.mint` authoritative on every
exit path: there is exactly one vault per job and a token account's mint is
immutable once initialized, so no substitute can be passed in its place.
Required when budget > 0.

accounts.name: hook_delegate
docs: Required when hook is present and budget > 0; approved on client_token_account for budget_amount.

accounts.name: delegate_whitelist
docs: is owned by a sub-hook (MultiHookRouter) rather than the job's hook program.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initializes the global `AcpState` PDA. Caller must be the program's upgrade authority.

instructions.name: migrate_state
docs: Reallocs the live `AcpState` account to the current layout and backfills
`sponsor` when unset. Idempotent. Authority-only.

accounts.name: acp_state
docs: field (offset [8..40]) against the signer in the handler.

instructions.name: nominate_authority
docs: Nominates a new authority for ownership transfer. Authority-only.

instructions.name: reject
docs: Rejects a job, refunding any escrowed tokens to the client.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: acp_state.sponsor. Distinct from platform_treasury, which receives SPL fees.

instructions.name: remove_hook_whitelist
docs: Removes a hook program from the whitelist by closing its PDA. Authority-only.

instructions.name: set_budget
docs: Sets the budget amount on an Open job. Provider-only.

instructions.name: set_evaluator_fee
docs: Updates the evaluator fee rate. Authority-only.

instructions.name: set_pause
docs: Toggles the global pause flag. When paused, all lifecycle instructions revert. Authority-only.

instructions.name: set_payment_token
docs: Updates the mint accepted for job budgets. Authority-only. Applies to
jobs funded after it; already-funded jobs are unaffected.

accounts.name: payment_token
docs: Typed as `Mint` so the new value must be a real SPL mint that exists,
the same guarantee `initialize` gives. This also makes a zero-address
value unrepresentable, so no explicit check is needed.

instructions.name: set_platform_fee
docs: Updates the platform fee rate and treasury address. Authority-only.

instructions.name: set_provider
docs: Assigns a provider to an Open job whose provider is currently unset.

instructions.name: set_sponsor
docs: Updates the wallet that receives reclaimed rent. Authority-only.

instructions.name: submit
docs: Records the provider's deliverable. Auto-completes if no evaluator is set.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Optional: required for auto-complete when budget > 0

accounts.name: provider_token_account
docs: Optional: required for auto-complete when budget > 0

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: Optional: required for auto-complete when budget > 0

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: acp_state.sponsor. Distinct from platform_treasury, which receives SPL fees.

accounts.name: hook_delegate
docs: sub-hook program. Required when hook is present and budget > 0; approved as
delegate on provider_hook_token_account for budget_amount.

accounts.name: provider_hook_token_account
docs: Optional: provider's token account used by the hook for escrow transfer.
Required when hook is present and budget > 0 and evaluator is set.

accounts.name: delegate_whitelist
docs: using MultiHookRouter -- the delegate is owned by a sub-hook, not the router.

types.name: AcpState
docs: Global program configuration. Singleton PDA seeded by `["acp_state"]`.

fields.name: authority
docs: Current program authority; can create/remove hook whitelists and update fees.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Nominated successor (two-step transfer). `None` until `nominate_authority` is called.

fields.name: payment_token
docs: SPL mint accepted for job budgets.

fields.name: platform_treasury
docs: Wallet that receives platform fees. Rent goes to `sponsor` instead.

fields.name: platform_fee_bp
docs: Platform fee in basis points (0-10000). Applied to vault balance on completion.

fields.name: evaluator_fee_bp
docs: Evaluator fee in basis points (0-10000). Applied on evaluator-confirmed completions.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: paused
docs: When true, all user-facing lifecycle instructions revert. Admin-toggled.
Appended after `bump` so the existing on-chain layout only grows by one byte.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Receives reclaimed native rent from every account close. Separate from
`platform_treasury`, which receives SPL fees: under gas sponsorship the
rent was never the user's money nor protocol revenue, it is the sponsor's
float coming back. Appended after `paused` so the layout only grows at
the tail; `migrate_state` backfills it from an explicit argument when
zero, since it must differ from `platform_treasury` and so cannot be
inferred from existing state.

types.name: AuthorityNominated
docs: Emitted when a new authority is nominated (first step of two-step transfer).

types.name: AuthorityTransferred
docs: Emitted when a pending authority accepts ownership (second step of two-step transfer).

types.name: BudgetSet
docs: Emitted when the budget is set on a job via `set_budget`.

types.name: EvaluatorFeePaid
docs: Emitted when the evaluator fee is transferred on evaluator-confirmed completion.

types.name: EvaluatorFeeUpdated
docs: Emitted when the evaluator fee rate is updated.

types.name: HookDetached
docs: Emitted when an admin detaches a hook from an in-flight job via `detach_hook`.

fields.name: hook_address
docs: The hook address that was detached, captured before it is cleared to None.

types.name: HookWhitelist
docs: Whitelist entry for an approved hook program. PDA seeded by `["hook_whitelist", hook]`.

fields.name: hook
docs: The whitelisted hook program ID.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

types.name: HookWhitelistUpdated
docs: Emitted when a hook program is added to or removed from the whitelist.

types.name: Job
docs: A single job. PDA seeded by `["job", client, job_id_le_bytes]`.
Every field here is read on-chain. `description`, `deliverable`,
`completion_reason` and `created_at` used to be stored and are now
event-only: nothing on-chain ever read them, and between them they were 365
of the account's 529 bytes. `description` alone was a 260-byte ceiling
allocated in full whatever the actual string. They are carried by
`JobCreated.description`, `JobSubmitted.deliverable`, `JobCompleted.reason`
and `JobRejected.reason`, plus the transaction's own block time.
The trade-off is deliberate and worth stating plainly: Solana `emit!` writes
to transaction logs, which are retrievable only for as long as an RPC keeps
history. Anything needing a durable audit trail of these values must index
the events off-chain.

fields.name: seed
docs: Client-supplied uniquifier, kept only so the PDA can be re-derived
(`seeds = [b"job", client, seed]`). It is NOT the job's identity and
carries no ordering: two clients may pick the same value, and `init`
rejects a reuse by the same client because the address already exists.
**The job's identity is its own address**, `job.key()`. That is what the
hooks seed their per-job PDAs from and what the CPI payload carries.
Deriving the address from a shared counter instead made every creation
contend on one account, capping the protocol at one job per slot.

fields.name: client
docs: The party that created and funds the job.

fields.name: provider
docs: The agent fulfilling the job. `Pubkey::default()` until set via `set_provider`.

fields.name: evaluator
docs: The adjudicator who completes or rejects. `Pubkey::default()` enables auto-complete on submit.

fields.name: state
docs: Current lifecycle state (see `JobState`).

fields.name: budget_amount
docs: Token amount escrowed on fund. Zero for zero-budget jobs.

fields.name: expired_at
docs: Unix timestamp after which the job may be claimed as expired.

fields.name: hook_address
docs: Optional hook program invoked on before/after action callbacks.

fields.name: vault_bump
docs: PDA bump for the per-job vault authority. Set during fund.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed for this job account.

types.name: JobCompleted
docs: Emitted when a job is completed (evaluator approval or auto-complete).

types.name: JobCreated
docs: Emitted when a new job is created via `create_job`.
`description` is carried here because it is no longer stored on the job.
Nothing on-chain reads it, and as a 260-byte ceiling allocated in full it was
49% of the account; this is now its only record, so an indexer that wants it
must capture it from this event.

types.name: JobExpired
docs: Emitted when an expired job is claimed via `claim_refund`.

types.name: JobFunded
docs: Emitted when a client funds a job, escrowing tokens in the vault.

types.name: JobRejected
docs: Emitted when a job is rejected by an evaluator, client, or provider.

types.name: JobState
docs: Job lifecycle states

types.name: JobSubmitted
docs: Emitted when a provider submits a deliverable.

types.name: PauseSet
docs: Emitted when the protocol pause flag is toggled via `set_pause`.

types.name: PaymentReleased
docs: Emitted when the net payment is transferred to the provider on completion.

types.name: PaymentTokenUpdated
docs: Emitted when the mint accepted for job budgets is rotated. Carries the
previous value so an indexer can tell which jobs were funded under which
allowlist without replaying every prior update.

types.name: PlatformFeeUpdated
docs: Emitted when the platform fee rate or treasury address is updated.

types.name: ProviderSet
docs: Emitted when a provider is assigned to a job via `set_provider`.

types.name: Refunded
docs: Emitted when escrowed tokens are returned to the client (rejection or expiry).

types.name: SponsorUpdated
docs: Emitted when the rent sponsor is updated via `set_sponsor`.
